# Weather Icons (moon phases)

`app/src/main/res/drawable/moon_phase_0.xml` … `moon_phase_7.xml` are converted from Erik Flowers'
**Weather Icons** (<https://github.com/erikflowers/weather-icons>), the outline-style "alt" moon
phases (`wi-moon-alt-new`, `-waxing-crescent-3`, `-first-quarter`, `-waxing-gibbous-3`, `-full`,
`-waning-gibbous-3`, `-third-quarter`, `-waning-crescent-3`), downloaded 2026-11-19.

- Icons licensed under the **SIL Open Font License 1.1** (<https://scripts.sil.org/OFL>); code under
  the MIT License.
- Changes: SVG paths copied into Android vector drawables (white fill, tinted at use).
